subject: Reasoning
q: How many times do the hour and minute hands of a clock coincide in 12 hours?
explanation: The minute hand overtakes the hour hand once every 720/11 minutes, so in 720 minutes they meet 11 times (the meeting at 12:00 is counted once).

explanation: The hands are opposite once in each overtaking cycle: 11 times in 12 hours, so 22 times in 24 hours.
